description: Company requests, including submissions without a linked account.
searchHint: Case-insensitive search within a company name or contact name. Special characters are treated as text.
statusHint: Enter the server value exactly. Leave empty for all statuses.
scope: Times use Asia/Almaty. Counts cover records accessible to your account; complete administrator access needs verification on the server.

empty.title: No requests yet
empty.body: The server returned no accessible requests. An empty response may also result from access restrictions.

noMatches.title: No matches found
noMatches.body: Change the search or exact status value, or clear the filters.

pageEmpty.title: No requests on this page
pageEmpty.body: The list may have changed. Return to the first page of these results.

errors.denied: The server denied read access. Check permissions.
errors.missing: The corporate requests source is unavailable in the API.
errors.invalid: The server did not return the expected page and exact count. Reload the data.
errors.unavailable: Could not load data. Try again.

validation.page: Invalid page number in the URL. Apply the filters again or clear them.
validation.filters: Search and status allow up to 256 characters without control characters. Each parameter must appear only once in the URL.
